text: Offers official TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs for connecting agents to tools
quote: Metorial gives developers official TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs to connect AI agents to tools in minutes.

text: Provides adapters (e.g. OpenAI chat completions) to plug Metorial sessions into agent frameworks
Runs OAuth flows letting end users authorize their own accounts on services like Slack, GitHub, Google Calendar
quote: OAuth lets your users authorize access to their accounts on services like Slack, GitHub, Google Calendar, and more.

text: Users can upload custom MCP server code and have Metorial host, scale, and monitor it
quote: Beyond the pre-built integrations in the Metorial catalog, you can upload your own MCP server code and let Metorial host it. Metorial handles scaling and monitoring.

text: Multiple providers/MCP servers can be attached to one session with their tools merged for the AI
quote: You can attach multiple providers—from the same provider or different ones—in a single session. The tools from all of them are merged and exposed to your AI.

text: Tool filters let you allow or restrict which tools from a provider are exposed in a session
quote: Tool filters let you control which tools from a provider are available during a session.

text: Deployments can be pinned to a specific version to prevent automatic updates in production
quote: You can optionally pin a deployment to a specific version to prevent automatic updates—useful when you need stability across a production environment.

text: Portals give branded pages where users discover and connect approved integrations and skills
quote: Portals are branded places where users discover and connect approved integrations, skills, and MCP access.

text: Teams can review traces, sessions, tool calls, auth events, and failures after agent runs
quote: Teams review traces, sessions, tool calls, auth events, and failures after work runs.

text: Magic Skills package repeatable agent workflows so teams can publish and govern them
quote: Magic Skills package repeatable workflows so teams can publish and govern useful agent work.

text: Can connect to a provider's existing remote MCP endpoint and use it like any other provider
quote: Use a remote MCP server when the provider already offers an MCP endpoint. Metorial connects to it and you can use it like any other provider on Metorial.

text: Built-in RBAC, SAML SSO, and IAM tie agent access to an org's existing security model
quote: RBAC, SAML SSO, and IAM built in so agent access follows your existing security model.

text: Returns a connection_url that an MCP client can connect to directly
quote: Returns a `connection_url` you can connect an MCP client to

text: SDK throws typed errors to help identify and handle specific failure scenarios
quote: The Metorial SDK throws typed errors that help you identify and handle specific failure scenarios.

text: Vercel AI SDK integration (@metorial/ai-sdk) is the recommended way to use Metorial in TypeScript
quote: The Vercel AI SDK integration (`@metorial/ai-sdk`) is the recommended way to use Metorial in TypeScript applications.

text: Supports all OpenAI-compatible model providers
quote: Metorial supports all of these OpenAI-compatible providers.

text: OpenAI provider integration exposes Metorial's MCP tools to GPT-4 and GPT-3.5
quote: The OpenAI provider integration lets you use Metorial's MCP tools with OpenAI's GPT models, including GPT-4 and GPT-3.5.

text: Anthropic provider integration exposes MCP tools to Claude Sonnet, Opus, and Haiku
quote: The Anthropic provider integration lets you use Metorial's MCP tools with Claude models (Sonnet, Opus, and Haiku).

text: Google provider integration exposes MCP tools to Gemini models
quote: The Google provider integration lets you use Metorial's MCP tools with Google's Gemini models.

text: Dashboard lets you generate publishable and secret API keys
quote: You can generate both publishable and secret API keys in your Metorial dashboard by navigating to Developer → API Keys and clicking Create API Key.

text: Each environment (e.g. sandbox vs production) has isolated deployments, keys, auth configs, and logs
quote: Each environment has its own provider deployments, API keys, authentication configs, and logs, so changes in a sandbox do not affect production.

text: Portal users can copy a standard MCP URL to connect their own AI client
quote: copy a standard MCP URL for their AI client

text: Each end user connects their own apps and keeps only their own permissions instead of shared broad credentials
quote: Instead of sharing broad credentials or over-scoped service accounts, each user connects their own apps and keeps the permissions they should have.

text: Teams can connect agent/MCP clients like Cursor, ChatGPT, and Claude to approved apps and skills with access controls and activity logs
quote: Let your team connect AI agents and MCP clients like Cursor, ChatGPT, and Claude to approved apps, tools, and shared skills, with access controls and activity logs.

text: Magic MCP server provides a single hosted MCP endpoint exposing a provider's tools
quote: A Magic MCP server gives you a hosted MCP endpoint for a provider. Metorial manages the server and makes the provider's tools available through one connection.

text: Agents area shows which agent clients connected and lets you inspect their tool calls and sessions
quote: The Agents area shows which agent clients have connected to Workforce and what they have done. Use it to investigate a tool call, review a session, or check how an agent connected.

text: Catalog offers 1200+ integrations across SaaS tools, enterprise systems, data sources, and custom MCP servers
quote: 1200+ integrations across SaaS tools, enterprise systems, data sources, and custom MCP servers.
